title: The image of nil-ideal units is the pushforward of the relative unit kernel.
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J ≤ I quasi-coherent ideals [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], and I ≤ the nilradical [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. Write i_J: Z_J → X and j: Z_I → Z_J for the inclusions. For the unit restriction q [def-sc-gm-torsor] and direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], the categorical image of ker(q_I) → Gm_X → (i_J)_*Gm_Z_J is isomorphic to (i_J)_* ker(q_j). No square-zero hypothesis is required.

source.place: Proof, Step 1 and its Claim; affine argument preserved in lem-sc-reduction-units-power-cokernel; extracted from the image comparison proof as NilIdealUnitImageRelativeKernel

proof.text: J ≤ I ≤ the nilradical implies that the closed immersion i_J has full support, by IdealSheafData.support_antitone and support_nilradical. Reuse the already proved private helper locallySurjective_gmSheafToLowerStar_of_thickening from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.Curve.ReductionUnitsEpi via a proof-only import all. This helper proves local surjectivity for every surjective closed immersion by affine unit lifting; it already uses isUnit_of_surjective_appTop and surjective_units_appTop, so none of those three statements is duplicated here. Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective makes p = gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf J.subschemeι epi. Only the general local-surjectivity helper is used, not the reduction-specific upperStar epimorphism theorem.

Put F = (i_J)_* and r = F.map(q_j). The isomorphism e = Etale.lowerStarComp identifies the target of r with that of q_I. On sections the pullback-pasting identity proves p ≫ r ≫ e.hom = q_I, using functoriality of global functions and of units, and IdealSheafData.inclusion_subschemeι. This is the proved helper gmSheafToLowerStar_comp.

The morphism k = kernel.map q_I r p e.inv is the pullback of p along kernel.ι r. Construct its pullback universal property directly with kernel.lift, cancelling the kernel inclusions for uniqueness. Abelian.epi_snd_of_isLimit proves k epi; strongEpi_of_epi makes it strong epi. The equality k ≫ kernel.ι r = kernel.ι q_I ≫ p and image.isoStrongEpiMono identify the categorical image with kernel r. This argument is fully proved in image_kernel_comp_iso. Finally compose with (PreservesKernel.iso F q_j).symm, using the already proved preservation of finite limits by lowerStar.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_nilIdealUnitImageRelativeKernelIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJI : J ≤ I) (hIN : I ≤ X.nilradical) :
    Nonempty (image (kernel.ι (gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf I.subschemeι) ≫
        gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf J.subschemeι) ≅
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} J.subschemeι).obj
        (kernel (gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf (IdealSheafData.inclusion hJI))))
